title: Closing Method Matrix for Larkspur Closing and Funding: Availability, Signing Format and Session Size
content:
Each Closing and Funding engagement at Larkspur Home Lending runs under exactly one of seven closing methods. The method fixes where it is offered, which loan files may use it, how the documents are signed and recorded, and how funds move at signing. The figures below are the method's own parameters and apply to every closing opened under that method.

## Where each method is offered and for which files

| Closing method | Property states offered | Loan programs | Loan purposes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | AK, AZ, CA, HI, ID, NV, NM, OR, WA | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | AK, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | AK, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | CO, FL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NV, OH, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI | every program except Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | AK, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | AK, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, HI, ID, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI | all seven Larkspur programs | purchase, rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |

"All seven Larkspur programs" means Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed, Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed and Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed.

## Entry condition of each method

| Closing method | Entry condition |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | the property lies in a wet-funding state |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | the property lies in AK, AZ, CA, HI, ID, NV, NM, OR or WA |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | the signing location lies within the 50-mile notary travel radius |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | E-SIGN consent is given and the county accepts electronic recording |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | E-SIGN consent is given, the state permits remote online notarization, and the program is not Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | the power of attorney is approved 5 business days before closing, and the loan purpose is purchase or rate-and-term refinance |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | the settlement agent is approved |

## Signing format and funding mode

| Closing method | Funds wired at signing (wet) | Notary physically present | eNote | E-SIGN consent required before drawing | Recording | After-hours signings offered | Most signers per session | Notary travel radius (miles) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | Yes | Yes | No | No | paper | No | 6 | 0 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | No | Yes | No | No | paper | No | 6 | 0 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | Yes | Yes | No | No | paper | Yes | 4 | 50 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | electronic recording | No | 6 | 0 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | electronic recording | Yes | 4 | 0 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | Yes | Yes | No | No | paper | No | 6 | 0 |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | No | Yes | No | No | paper | No | 6 | 0 |

"Funds wired at signing" No means funds are wired after the signed package is reviewed (a dry closing). "Most signers per session" counts borrowers and title holders together. A travel radius of 0 means the method does not use a travelling notary.

## Reading the matrix

- A file whose property is in NJ can use the Traditional Wet, Mobile Notary, Hybrid eClosing, Power of Attorney or Mail-Away method, but not the Escrow Dry-Funding or Remote Online Notarization method, because NJ is not on those two lists.
- A cash-out refinance cannot close under the Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing, whose purposes are purchase and rate-and-term refinance only.
- Only the Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing closes on an eNote; the Larkspur Hybrid eClosing signs electronically with a paper note.
